AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

2. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. newton (N)
   C. watt (W)
   D. pascal (Pa)

3. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

4. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Producers

5. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 37 °C

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Breeds of Livestock? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Breeds of Livestock.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Breeds of Livestock.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Breeds of Livestock.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Breeds of Livestock.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growing Selected Crop? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growing Selected Crop.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Growing Selected Crop.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Growing Selected Crop.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Selected Crop.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Properties of soil? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Properties of soil.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Properties of soil.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Properties of soil.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Properties of soil.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Land Preparation? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Land Preparation.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Land Preparation.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Land Preparation.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Land Preparation.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Field Management Practices? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Field Management Practices.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Field Management Practices.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Field Management Practices.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Field Management Practices.

12. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Nitrogen gas only

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safe Handling of Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safe Handling of Animals.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Safe Handling of Animals.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safe Handling of Animals.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safe Handling of Animals.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Protection: Weed control? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Protection: Weed control.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Protection: Weed control.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Protection: Weed control.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Protection: Weed control.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Agricultural Land? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agricultural Land.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Agricultural Land.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Agricultural Land.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Agricultural Land.

16. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Growing Selected Crops 1.6 Crop Protection: Weed control 1.7 General Crop Harves and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Growing Selected Crop and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Crop Protection: Weed control and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain General Crop Harvesting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe Handling of Animals 2.3 General Animal Health 2.4 B and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
